014package org.microbean.bean;
015
016import java.util.Arrays;
017import java.util.Collection;
018import java.util.Collections;
019import java.util.List;
020import java.util.Objects;
021import java.util.SequencedSet;
022
023import org.microbean.interceptor.InterceptionFunction;
024import org.microbean.interceptor.InterceptorMethod;
025
026import static org.microbean.interceptor.Interceptions.ofConstruction;
027
028// Applies around-construct logic to contextual instance production.
029public final class InterceptingProducer<I> implements Producer<I> {
030
031  private final InterceptionFunction f;
032
033  private final Producer<I> producer;
034
035  public InterceptingProducer(final Collection<? extends InterceptorMethod> interceptorMethods,
036                              final Producer<I> producer) {
037    super();
038    this.producer = Objects.requireNonNull(producer, "producer");
039    this.f = ofConstruction(interceptorMethods, (t, a) -> this.produce(Collections.unmodifiableList(Arrays.asList(a))));
040  }
041
042  @Override // Producer<I>
043  public final List<Assignment> assign(final Request<?> r) {
044    return this.producer.assign(r);
045  }
046
047  @Override // Producer<I>
048  public final SequencedSet<Dependency> dependencies() {
049    return this.producer.dependencies();
050  }
051
052  @Override // Producer<I>
053  public final void dispose(final I i, final Request<I> r) {
054    this.producer.dispose(i, r);
055  }
056
057  @Override // Producer<I>
058  @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
059  public final I produce(final Request<I> r) {
060    return (I)this.f.apply(this.dependencies().stream()
061                           .map(d -> new Assignment(d, r).value())
062                           .toArray());
063  }
064
065  @Override // Producer<I>
066  public final I produce(final List<?> dependentContextualReferences) {
067    return this.producer.produce(dependentContextualReferences);
068  }
069
070}
